task.title: Advance search-svc to autonomous durable index pipeline
task.summary_zh: 把 search-svc 從 caller-supplied documents query wrapper 推進成 server-side durable index/search pipeline：由 source/evidence store 建索引，查詢端不需每次帶 documents，並保留 governed citation/filter semantics。
acceptance: search service maintains a durable server side index from source or evidence records
query endpoint works without caller supplied documents
governed citations filters access scope and snapshot replay remain enforced
BFF or smoke verifies service backed search against persisted indexed data
task.next: Owner finalized approved durable search index pipeline. Review approval recorded; durable evidence-backed search, BFF no-documents query path, compose evidence mount, persisted replay, and mixed-scope ACL/citation isolation are closed.
review_notes_zh: Reviewer 發現並補上 mixed-scope source evidence 的 ACL/citation isolation：source-ingest 產生 knowledge object 時改用 per-record evidence item access_scope，search result citation 改為 matched evidence item citation，避免同一 bundle 內 private citation/record 混入 operator 查詢。

驗證通過：pytest services/search/tests -q；pytest services/source_ingestion/test_service.py -q；pytest services/search/tests/test_http_service.py services/search/tests/test_service_activation_contract.py services/control-plane/bff/test_search_service_client.py services/source_ingestion/test_compose_activation.py -q；in-memory compile ok 33 files。compileall 曾因既有 services/control-plane/bff/__pycache__ 權限問題無法寫 pyc，非語法錯。

handoffs.message: Search durable index pipeline implemented: search-svc now reloads durable source evidence JSONL, query works without documents, compose shares source-ingest evidence store read-only, BFF stops sending documents, and smoke verifies persisted indexed data plus snapshot replay. Tests: pytest services/search/tests -q; pytest services/search/tests/test_http_service.py services/search/tests/test_service_activation_contract.py services/control-plane/bff/test_search_service_client.py services/source_ingestion/test_compose_activation.py -q; compile check passed via in-memory compile.

Review approved after reviewer ACL/citation isolation fix; owner should finalize to done. Search now reloads durable source evidence, query works without caller documents, BFF stops sending documents, compose shares source-ingest evidence read-only, smoke/test coverage includes persisted index replay plus mixed-scope filtering.
